attribution: Fonte: Tabela FIPE (Fundação Instituto de Pesquisas Econômicas); IPCA: IBGE.

cohort.description: Cars bought new in January Y: share of the purchase price left by age (real and nominal).

cohort_pooled.description: The cohort pooled over every purchase year, by age (depends on the years pooled).

loss_by_age.description: Same used car from one January to the next, by age, without the 2022 shock year.

four_year_change.description: Same used car over four years, for every start January (what was left of 2022).

holds_value.description: Five years after purchase, relative to cars bought new the same year and price band.

version_gap.description: Top against entry version of the same model family bought new the same year.

fuel_relabels.description: Cars whose FIPE fuel label changed between two Januaries (2011 diesel, 2024 flex).

yearly_change.description: Same used car from one January to the next: median change (nominal, real) and IPCA.

new_vs_used.description: Used car of the current model year over the same car brand new, per January.

retention_by_age.description: Share of the brand-new price kept at each age, same January (all years and recent).

coverage.description: Prices, brand-new prices, FIPE codes and brands per reference month.

explore_retention.description: retention_by_age by brand, fuel group and brand-new price band (explore page).

explore_yearly.description: Real change of the same used car per January by brand, fuel group and price band.

fuel_labels.description: Prices per fuel label and January (FIPE split the Gasolina label in 2024).

clean_report.description: What cleaning dropped: invalid rows, duplicates and fuel group collisions.
